share_total_deviations.issue: Documented unresolved source issue (formerly 'D1'): in each listed player-season the source's 2PT-range share + 3PT share equals 1 (within rounding), but the five distance-zone shares do not total 1 beyond the 3-decimal rounding tolerance, because the four 2PT zones sum to more or less than the 2PT-range share. Some 2PT attempts are therefore unassigned to (or over-assigned to) a zone. The dataset does not say why; unresolved at source.

trace_lowest_display_record.conclusion: Source inconsistency: the source's 2PT-range share (81.4%) is larger than the sum of its four 2PT zones (78.2%); ~3.2% of attempts (~5 of 156) are not assigned to any zone. 3PT share is exact (29/156). Cause is not documented in the dataset; unresolved at source.

estimate_reconciliation_total_makes_vs_F.note: error = sum of per-zone estimated makes − reported season FGM. 'displayed' replicates the interface (attempts rounded first, then makes).

displayed_error_bound: 0.0025 × FGA + 5 (share rounding + five-zone count rounding), applied to records with consistent share totals
